observed: R0-R3 exact (0.0) on all nine states. R4 diffs (restore with x0 := 0 minus removed_at, nats): +0.0047, +0.0002, +0.0061, -0.0074, -0.0073, +0.0195 (r2_t359_v816/s1, against 1e-2: FAIL). Mixed signs, size below 1% of the removal's own effect (T1 - removed_at lo = 2.62 nats on the failing state).
why the old tolerance was wrong: it was set without measuring the noise floor. The two paths round differently under bf16 autocast: removed_at runs one matmul with W - sum u v^T cast to bf16, the restore runs x W^T plus a separate bf16 correction (x0 - x) V U. R4 exists to catch a sign or U/V orientation error; a flipped sign would read about twice the removal's effect (~5 nats here), more than 100 x the observed diffs.
new rule: R4 passes on a state when |diff| <= 0.05 nats and |diff| <= 0.02 x |T1 - lo of removed_at(S)|.
